us.title: RBA preview - Westpac says soft Q2 CPI gives RBA room to hold at 4.35%
us.description: Major banks converging on a hold call . Westpac, like CBA earlier is looking for on hold tomorrow from the Reserve Bank of Australia, a strong signal for AUD stability around the August meeting. The softer Q2 CPI print has genuinely shifted the consensus. Westpac's framing that only the downside risks it had flagged actually materialised, and that energy cost pass-through from the Middle East conflict has not continued into recent months, lines up closely with CBA's own point that June's inflation data showed higher input costs were not broadly flowing through to consumers. Both banks expect the RBA to keep hawkish language even while holding, which should limit how much a hold alone moves AUD, with the more important signal being whether the Board's tone shifts materially dovish or stays cautious. The oil and energy angle is the one area where this cuts across our Iran war coverage, since a renewed spike in Middle East driven fuel costs would be the clearest way to revive the pass-through risk both banks currently see as contained, and would complicate the case for staying on hold much further into the year. --- Westpac and CBA are both calling a hold for August, and both point to the same signal, energy cost pass-through has quietly stopped. Summary: Westpac expects the RBA to leave the cash rate unchanged at 4.35% at its August meeting Q2 CPI came in below Westpac's forecasts on both headline and trimmed mean measures, with only the downside risks it had flagged materialising Westpac says the earlier pass-through of higher Middle East driven energy costs has not continued into recent months Westpac expects the RBA to retain a hawkish posture while it assesses incoming data over coming months The call aligns with CBA's own on-hold view, which cited slowing growth, softer inflation, faster labour market easing and weaker housing CBA's June inflation read similarly found higher input costs were not broadly passing through to consumers, reinforcing Westpac's assessment Westpac said it expects the Reserve Bank's Monetary Policy Board to leave the cash rate unchanged at 4.35 percent at its August meeting, pointing to a softer than expected second quarter inflation print as the key reason the Board has room to hold. The bank's economists said Q2 CPI came in below their forecasts on both a headline and trimmed mean basis, adding that only the downside risks they had flagged in their preview ended up materialising. Westpac described the result as welcome news, noting that the substantial pass-through of higher energy costs seen in the early phase of the Middle East conflict has not been followed up by further pass-through in recent months. Even so, the bank expects the Board to retain a hawkish posture as it works through the coming months of data, arguing that if inflation continues behaving as expected, policymakers can gain confidence that price growth is returning to target under existing settings without needing to move rates further. The call echoes the view set out by Commonwealth Bank of Australia ahead of the same meeting, which also expects the RBA to hold in August and for the remainder of 2026, citing slowing growth, softer than forecast inflation, faster labour market easing and a weaker housing market. CBA's own read of the June inflation data found that higher input costs were not broadly flowing through to consumer prices, a conclusion that lines up closely with Westpac's assessment that Middle East driven energy cost pass-through has stalled. Both banks expect the RBA to keep flagging its willingness to hike again if conditions warrant it, even without an immediate case to tighten given the current data. With two of the major banks now aligned on a hold, attention is likely to shift toward the RBA's updated economic forecasts and the tone of Governor commentary at the meeting for signs of how much confidence the Board has gained that inflation is on a sustainable path back to target. The decision is due Tuesday, 11 August 2026 at 2:30pm Sydney time (04:30 GMT, 12:30am US Eastern), with Governor Michele Bullock's press conference following an hour later at 3:30pm Sydney time (05:30 GMT, 1:30am US Eastern) This article was written by Eamonn Sheridan at investinglive.com.

Netanyahu Rejects Gaza Plan: Israel Won't Withdraw Until Hamas Is 'Genuinely Disarmed'
us.description: Netanyahu Rejects Gaza Plan: Israel Won't Withdraw Until Hamas Is 'Genuinely Disarmed' Authored by Tom Gantert via The Epoch Times , Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu restated on Aug. 9 that Israel has rejected U.S. President Donald Trump's Board of Peace's plan for Gaza and will not withdraw until Hamas is fully disarmed. Palestinians walk past the rubble of residential buildings destroyed during the war, at Jabalia refugee camp in the northern Gaza Strip on Aug. 5, 2026. Mahmoud Issa/Reuters Trump posted on Truth Social in July that an agreement had been reached for the complete disarmament of Hamas and other armed groups in Gaza. Trump said the agreement is part of his plan that will be implemented in phases. As disarmament takes place, Israeli forces would withdraw , while an International Stabilization Force and a new Palestinian police force would assume responsibility for security. Gaza would ultimately be governed by a new Palestinian government working with the Board of Peace. The Board of Peace is an international organization chaired by Trump that seeks to promote stability, establish lawful governance, and secure lasting peace in areas affected by conflict. Its founding members include the United States, Israel, Egypt, Qatar, Saudi Arabia, Turkey, and more than 20 other countries committed to international peace-building efforts, according to its website. Speaking at the start of a government meeting on Aug. 9, Netanyahu said disarmament must include all of Hamas's weapons and must be genuine rather than "fictitious." He said Israel is discussing the issue with the United States and that some U.S. proposals are acceptable to Israel, while others are not. Netanyahu also said Israeli forces would continue acting against threats to Israeli troops and civilians. He rejected the establishment of a Palestinian state. "As for the Gaza Strip: First and foremost, I wish to clarify the main point: As long as I am Prime Minister, a Palestinian state will not be established, neither in Gaza nor in Judea and Samaria ," Netanyahu said in a statement. He also addressed Iran and Lebanon, pledging to prevent Iran from obtaining a nuclear weapon and saying Israel is conducting an important military operation in Lebanon aimed at eliminating threats. Israel has been conducting operations in Lebanon. Two Israeli reservists were killed and four others were seriously wounded during operations recently in southern Lebanon, according to the Israeli military. Lebanese authorities said an Israeli strike also killed one person and wounded 12 others in the town of Tibnin, Lebanon. Israel gave an evacuation warning to residents before the strike. The incidents come as the United States conducts talks aimed at reducing hostilities along the Israel-Lebanon border and advancing a broader peace agreement. U.S. officials said the discussions include the disarmament of Hezbollah and other Iran-backed threats, the redeployment of Israeli forces from southern Lebanon , and the implementation of a pilot zone process transferring security responsibilities to the Lebanese army. sg.description: HEFEI, China , Aug. 10, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- Sungrow, the global leading PV inverter and energy storage system (ESS) provider, has once again been named the No. 1 PV Inverter shipments by S&P Global 2025. This achievement reflects Sungrow's continuous commitment to technological innovation, global expansion, and customer-centric services. This solution delivers enhanced efficiency, optimized costs, and improved system stability across diverse application scenarios. Sungrow has also achieved the world's first field engineering validation of wide-frequency oscillation solutions, demonstrating its capability to address emerging challenges in modern power systems and support the integration of renewable energy at scale. These innovations revealed Sungrow's strong R&D capability, with technical professionals accounting for approximately 40% of its workforce. Expanding Global Presence with Localized Capabilities Sungrow's global footprint now spans more than 100 countries and regions, supported by 4 global manufacturing bases and the industry's most extensive grid access capabilities. With more than 1 TW of accumulated global grid-connected experience, Sungrow leverages its advanced manufacturing capabilities and an agile global supply chain to continuously provide compliant, localized, and efficient solutions across diverse markets worldwide. Delivering Lifecycle Support Through Professional Services Beyond technology and products, Sungrow has established a global service network with more than 520 service locations, over 1,200 technical service engineers, and more than 400 authorized service partners. By combining advanced hardware, digital solutions, and localized service capabilities, this extensive ecosystem enables rapid response, localized support, and professional assistance from project deployment to long-term operation and maintenance. With Sungrow's cutting-edge inverter technologies, strengthening global manufacturing capabilities, and building a comprehensive customer service network worldwide, Sungrow will continue to support the construction of new-type power systems and bridge to a sustainable future.

th.description: จากกรณีที่หนุ่มป่วยใบหน้าบวมครึ่งซีก ปวดจนทนไม่ไหวเกิดจากฟันผุและไม้จิ้มฟันทําให้ต้องโพสต์ขอความช่วยเหลือบนโลกโซเชียลแต่กลับถูกชาวเน็ตกลับด่าว่าเป็น เอไอหลอกลวง จนกลายเป็นกระแสวิพากษ์วิจารณ์ไปก่อนหน้านี้นั้น วานนี้ 10 สิงหาคม 2569 เพจเฟซบุ๊กดังอย่างเมศ เจ้าชายน้อย โพสต์เรื่องราวสุดสะเทือนใจและบีบคั้นหัวใจของ พี่ปูอายุ 31 ปี ที่ต้องเผชิญกับความเจ็บปวดทรมานจากโรคร้ายบนใบหน้าโดยมีข้อความระบุว่าไม้จิ้มฟัน - ฟันผุ มันปวด ทรมานมากพี่ ผมไม่รู้เลยว่าผมจะอยู่ได้อีกนานแค่ไหน ถ้ามีมาหาผมครั้งหน้า พี่อาจไม่เจอผมแล้วก็ได้ ผมลงรูปขอความช่วยเหลือ คนในสื่อออนไลน์บอกว่าผมตกแต่งรูป ทํา AI หลอกลวง เข้ามาด่า มาว่า ผมก็ไม่รู้จะทํายังไง พี่ปู อายุ 31 ปี พักอาศัยอยู่ในห้องเล็กๆกับแฟน 2 คนในจังหวัดแห่งหนึ่ง จุดเริ่มต้นมันเพียงแค่ ฟันผุ เท่านั้น พอฟันผุก็มีเศษอาหารไปติด พอเศษอาหารไปติดก็เอา ไม้จิ้มฟัน ไปแคะออก ทําบ่อยๆ จนเกิดการอักเสบ และกลายเป็นเนื้อร้ายก้อนใหญ่บนบริเวณใบหน้าด้านซ้าย เบื้องต้นเมศให้เงินยังชีพ จํานวนหนึ่ง เพื่อช่วยเหลือเบื้องต้น ครับ ข้อมูลรายละเอียดเบื้องต้น และการถ่ายรูป ถ่ายคลิป นํามาลงสื่อ เมศได้รับอนุญาตจากคนป่วยและแฟนคนป่วยเรียบร้อยแล้วครับ หลังจากที่โพสต์ของเพจเฟซบุ๊กเมศ เจ้าชายน้อย เผยแพร่ลงมาบนโลกออนไลน์ ทําเอาชาวเน็ตเข้าไปคอมเมนต์แสดงความคิดเห็นกันเป็นรจํานวนมาก เช่น จริงๆถ้าฟันผุ ถอน อุดเถอะครับ 800-1000 บาทเซฟชีวิตเรา พี่เขาเคยมาโพสใน กลุ่ม บริจาค ขอรับ ทิชชู่ แห้ง ถ้าจําไม่ผิด เขาอยู่ อําเภอใกล้เคียง มาผ่าตัดออกได้นะคะ สิทธิ์ 30 บาทก็ครอบคลุมค่ะ ผมขอยืนยันว่าเป็นเรื่องจิงนะครับน้องคนนี้เคยมาทํารถที่ร้านผมบ่อยๆครับ ไม่ใช่Ai ร้อยเปอร์เซ็นครับ ผมฟันพุมา สิบกว่า 8ซี่ ก็ปกติ ดีใช้ชีวิต ผมใช้ภูมิปัญญาโบราณ สมุนไพร แก้จากข้างใน และใช้ยาสีฟันทําเอง ถ้าผมปวดฟัน ผมกินแค่1-2แก้ว หาย แต่ดูภาพเหมือน ai จริง มันดูไม่ออกจริงนะ ถ้าไม่บอกก็คงคิดว่า ai ใช้ floss กันน่ะ ปลอดภัยกว่า พกติดตัว ไม้จิ้มฟันบางทีอันตรายกว่า พี่ผสุดยอด บวมขนาดนั้น ทําไมตา และปาก ไม่รั้ง แบบนี้เขาเรียกว่าเชื้อมาจากรากฟันค่ะถ้าเกิดว่าเป็นได้น้อยหมอเขาจะรักษารากฟันให้ค่ะเพราะเคยมีเคสแบบนี้แล้วก็เลยเป็นความรู้ไว้ค่ะหมอเขาถึงได้ให้ประชาชนถ้าเป็นเยอะให้รักษารากฟัน 2 ครั้งประมาณ 4,000 บาทค่ะ ขอขอบคุณข้อมูลและภาพจาก เฟซบุ๊กเมศ เจ้าชายน้อย

Phinma returns to profitability on strength of education business
ph.description: Del Rosario-led Phinma Corp. posted a turnaround in the first half of 2026, with a consolidated net income of ₱363.35 million and an attributable net income of ₱20.11 million from losses of ₱226.92 million and ₱455.06 million, respectively, in the same period last year. In a disclosure to the Philippine Stock Exchange (PSE) on Monday, Aug. 10, Phinma said this was despite an 11.7-percent decline in consolidated revenues to ₱9.55 billion in the first half of this year from ₱10.82 billion registered in the same period of 2025. Phinma said this performance reflects the consistent growth in its education business; more efficient operations in the construction materials segment; the continuation of regional development projects in properties and community housing; and stable domestic demand in hospitality. “The weaker economic environment tempered the performance this period: ongoing tensions in the Gulf region contributed to fluctuations in foreign exchange rates, higher borrowing costs, and continued caution among both businesses and consumers,” the firm said. It added that, locally, these challenges were compounded by delays in government spending and a slowdown in construction activity. “In the first half of the year, our strategic business units continued to adapt to challenging industry conditions and a softer economic environment,” said Phinma Chairman and Chief Executive Officer (CEO) Ramon R. del Rosario Jr. He noted, “As we build on this progress, we look forward to key milestones in the months ahead, including the opening of the Panabo cement facility and the Porac insulated panels plant, as well as the continued growth in student enrollment across our schools.” “While economic uncertainty lingers, we remain committed to pursuing opportunities that build on the strengths of our businesses and extend our impact to more Filipino families and communities,” Del Rosario added. Phinma Education Holdings Inc. reported a 14-percent growth in revenues to ₱3.12 billion from ₱2.74 billion, while consolidated net income jumped 47 percent to ₱819.75 million from ₱558.21 million last year. These figures were driven by sustained enrollment growth during the second semester of school year (SY) 2025-2026 and the summer term, as well as continued cost management initiatives to keep education affordable for low-income students. Phinma’s construction materials segment continued to focus on operational efficiency, margin enhancement, and strategic growth investments amid a challenging market environment. The segment had combined revenues of ₱5.28 billion and a combined net loss of ₱35.59 million as of June 2026. Phinma Property Holdings Corp. posted consolidated revenues of ₱698.02 million and a consolidated net loss of ₱378.64 million during the first half of 2026. Meanwhile, Phinma’s hospitality segment generated combined revenues of ₱300.3 million and combined net income of ₱27.2 million for the first six months of the year. Domestic leisure travel and continued demand from corporate guests across the network of hotels drove this performance amid headwinds from ongoing geopolitical conflicts. - James A. Loyola

ph.title: Sungrow Retains No.1 Position in 2025 S&P Global PV Inverter Shipments Rankings
ph.description: HEFEI, China , Aug. 10, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- Sungrow, the global leading PV inverter and energy storage system (ESS) provider, has once again been named the No. 1 PV Inverter shipments by S&P Global 2025. This achievement reflects Sungrow's continuous commitment to technological innovation, global expansion, and customer-centric services. Sungrow Ranks No.1 in Inverter Shipment for 2025 Driving Breakthroughs Via Technological Innovation Sungrow has launched the world's first PowerMatrix Inverter at SNEC 2026, introducing a new approach to inverter system architecture. This solution delivers enhanced efficiency, optimized costs, and improved system stability across diverse application scenarios. Sungrow has also achieved the world's first field engineering validation of wide-frequency oscillation solutions, demonstrating its capability to address emerging challenges in modern power systems and support the integration of renewable energy at scale. These innovations revealed Sungrow's strong R&D capability, with technical professionals accounting for approximately 40% of its workforce. Expanding Global Presence with Localized Capabilities Sungrow's global footprint now spans more than 100 countries and regions, supported by 4 global manufacturing bases and the industry's most extensive grid access capabilities. With more than 1 TW of accumulated global grid-connected experience, Sungrow leverages its advanced manufacturing capabilities and an agile global supply chain to continuously provide compliant, localized, and efficient solutions across diverse markets worldwide. Delivering Lifecycle Support Through Professional Services Beyond technology and products, Sungrow has established a global service network with more than 520 service locations, over 1,200 technical service engineers, and more than 400 authorized service partners. By combining advanced hardware, digital solutions, and localized service capabilities, this extensive ecosystem enables rapid response, localized support, and professional assistance from project deployment to long-term operation and maintenance. With Sungrow's cutting-edge inverter technologies, strengthening global manufacturing capabilities, and building a comprehensive customer service network worldwide, Sungrow will continue to support the construction of new-type power systems and bridge to a sustainable future.
